状态时间是序列计数投影，不是外部本体假设
title.en: State time is a sequence-count projection, not an external ontology assumption

title.zh: 维度可作为解释压缩坐标，而非对象固有标签
title.en: Dimension can be an explanatory compression coordinate rather than an intrinsic label

title.zh: 黑洞边界可表达为自维持系统的外部信息失配
title.en: A black-hole boundary can be expressed as external information mismatch in a self-maintaining system

title.zh: 生命式系统需要主动变体生成，而不只是被动复制
title.en: Life-like systems require active variant generation, not only passive copying

title.zh: 形式系统外推必须保留可证明、可反驳、独立与欠定四个出口
title.en: Formal-system extrapolation must keep provable, refutable, independent, and underdetermined exits

title.zh: CAI 中间层会持续提高意图中继保真度
title.en: CAI middle layer will keep improving intent relay fidelity

title.zh: 结构化 API 提示在 token 紧张时更准但更窄
title.en: Structured API prompts will be narrower but more accurate under token pressure

title.zh: 身份与社会退出成本比单纯经济补贴更能推动制度采纳
title.en: Identity and social exit costs will matter more than economic subsidies for adoption

title.zh: 部分退出通道会先于稳定制度转型出现
title.en: Partial exit channels will appear before durable institutional transition

title.zh: 高不确定下的决策系统会更久保留三轨结构
title.en: Decision systems under high uncertainty will retain tri-track structure longer

title.zh: 分批投入在多次 regime shift 中会比一次性投入更稳
title.en: Incremental investing will stay more robust than lump-sum investing across regime shifts

title.zh: 跨领域门控问题会逼迫模型拆成多种门控族
title.en: Cross-domain gate problems will force models to split into multiple gate families

title.zh: 显式反馈回路会把预测误差转成更高层意识信号
title.en: Explicit feedback loops will convert prediction error into higher-order awareness signals

title.zh: 大统一应该追求Φ极小而不是α相等
title.en: Grand unification should minimize Phi rather than force equal couplings

title.zh: 引力的弱是层级间距的数学必然
title.en: Gravity is weak because of hierarchy spacing

title.zh: 黑洞信息悖论更像部分保留而不是完全丢失
title.en: The black-hole information paradox is partial retention, not total loss

title.zh: 秦统一失败不是因为硬件不够，而是退出权被压成了符号
title.en: Qin failed because exit rights were compressed into symbols, not because the hardware was insufficient

title.zh: 物理学七团乌云共享同一容斥根因
title.en: The physics seven clouds share one inclusion-exclusion root

title.zh: 量子引力是同一势能面在过渡区的统一描述
title.en: Quantum gravity is the unified description of one potential surface in the transition zone

title.zh: 暗物质更像容斥交叉项的宏观表现
title.en: Dark matter is more like a macroscopic manifestation of inclusion-exclusion cross terms

title.zh: 暗能量灾变是容斥对消后的净值问题
title.en: The dark-energy catastrophe is a question of the net value after inclusion-exclusion cancellation

title.zh: 哈勃常数危机是不同截面的幽灵效应差异
title.en: The Hubble crisis is a difference in ghost effects across different cross-sections

title.zh: 层级问题是 d=4 稳定性约束的解析解
title.en: The hierarchy problem is the analytic solution of the d=4 stability constraint

title.zh: 黑洞信息在极小点遗迹中以相变方式释放
title.en: Black-hole information is released as a phase transition in the remnant of a vanished minimum

title.zh: 宇宙波函数不可知是子系统门控限制的结果
title.en: Cosmic wavefunction unknowability follows from subsystem gating limits
